page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 8 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor delivers modest performance. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests place the CPU in the bottom 25%, while Geekbench single-core scores fall into the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show weak read performance for both small and large blocks, though large block write bandwidth achieves an average rating. Cryptographic and database operations, including Redis SET benchmarks, also rank in the bottom 25%.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is its lower compute and memory read performance relative to newer hardware generations, balanced by its high memory density. This resource profile makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand high-frequency CPU performance. It is suitable for caching layers, medium-sized databases, and general-purpose memory-heavy applications that can operate within a 2 Gbps network baseline.
